purpose: bounded resource/throughput observation only; not a reference solve

budget.stop_when: first of complete diagnostic step >=2048 or 1800s since process start

performance_windows.timing_basis: monotonic external observation of complete newline-terminated diagnostic records; retain observed endpoints and actual delta-step; no per-step exact timestamps assumed
performance_windows.endpoint_selection: start is first observed sample at or above 256 or 1024 respectively; end is first later sample at least start_step+512; intervals may overlap and actual endpoints must be retained

required_measurements: parent-recorded planned-stop reason; timeout flag preserved
complete raw diagnostics with incomplete final line preserved and separately marked
last complete diagnostic step as lower bound only if process interrupted
original byte-identical native outputs including formal_simulation flag when present
missing result/completion/native execution-audit as missing; never synthesize
checkpoint/restart unsupported; no formal continuation or data promotion
blockers_for_next_direction: nonfinite diagnostics or frozen safety guard violation
missing or insufficient required performance intervals
